PM Modi launches ex-President Kovind's autobiography, advises youth on hard work

Prime Minister Narendra Modi attended the launch of former President Ram Nath Kovind's autobiography. During the event, Modi urged young people to read autobiographies and cautioned them against seeking shortcuts, stating that "shortcuts will cut you short." He specifically mentioned the culture of social media reels and short-form content as examples of this shortcut mentality. The Prime Minister also praised Kovind's generosity and adherence to Indian values.
